BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing horse racing handicapping contestsfor patrons of a class 1 racing association live race meet; and addinga new section to chapter 67.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A handicapping contest authorized by the commission involving theoutcome of multiple horse races and conducted by a licensed class 1racing association for patrons at a live race meet is not subject tothe provisions of this chapter or to any commission rules.
